verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's API docs describe a directory graph with 'indirect and directly bound objects', and other docs reference groups and automated access changes. That implies access can be bound through groups rather than granted one by one, but the evidence only glances at this. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of dynamic or rule-based group membership, explicit group-based SSO app assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants

citations.quote: traverse the JumpCloud Graph to return all indirect and directly bound objects in your organization
operate at scale by performing bulk operations across users, devices, and groups
Automate identity creation, access changes, and identity and access termination throughout the identity lifecycle.
